newsitem.title: FRANCE: Massonaud raises Cr National rating.
newsitem.headline: Massonaud raises Cr National rating.

text.p: Brokerage Massonaud-Fontenay-Kervern raised its rating on shares in Credit National to 'plus' from 'neutral', portfolio managers said on Tuesday.
They said the upgrade was prompted by Credit National chairman Emmanuel Rodocanachi's remarks in an interview with the newspaper Les Echos about possible changes in the shareholder structure.
Rodocanachi said the group was looking for shareholders inspiring "maximum confidence" and did not rule out a foreign bank partner.

Over the past two months, a quarter of its capital has changed hands. Insurer Axa, whose stake in Credit National has risen to 12.48 percent from 9.18 percent as a result of the Axa-UAP merger, is expected to reduce it to 10 percent or less under a prior shareholder accord.
Credit National shares were unchanged at 351 francs at 1620 GMT.
